items.name: DerivedKind
items.doc: Derived (price-based) chart data model. Layers, kept strictly apart: 1. Observed market data — the candlestick series in SeriesStore (never modified). 2. Derived representation — DerivedPoint[] on a LOGICAL index (one point per brick, line, column or range bar; several points may come from one source candle). 3. Display coordinates — the renderer maps logical index → x and derived price → y. 4. Executable prices — always the source candles' prices (`sourceClose`); a derived value (e.g. a Renko brick boundary) is a chart construct, never a traded price. No timestamps are invented: each point carries the time of the source candle that produced it, and several points may share one source time.

members.name: lookback
members.doc: Finite memory: the value at bar i depends only on bars [i - lookback, i]. When set, live updates recompute only the tail. Omit for recursive indicators (EMA, RSI, ...): those are recalculated in full, once per frame at most.

members.name: update
members.signature: update(input: IndicatorInput, p: IndicatorParams, prev: IndicatorResult, from: number): IndicatorResult
members.doc: Optional exact incremental update from bar `from` onward (mutates and returns `prev`).

members.name: stream
members.signature: stream(p: IndicatorParams, ctx: { intraday: boolean; }): StreamSpec
members.doc: Streaming (incremental) form: graph nodes per output. When present the chart evaluates the indicator incrementally (exact, O(1)–O(window) per live update) and shares common nodes with other indicators. `calculate` remains the reference full calculation.

members.name: meta
members.signature: meta?: { formula: string; incremental: "exact" | "full"; missing: string; conventions?: string; limitations?: string; repaint?: string }
members.doc: Catalogue metadata: formula, incremental support, missing-data policy, conventions, limitations.

members.name: requires
members.doc: Data beyond OHLC that the indicator needs ("volume", "time" for session resets, …). Used to decide where it is meaningful (e.g. not on price-based charts, which have no volume).

items.name: IndicatorInput
items.doc: Columnar price input given to calculations (only bars that exist: gaps are removed).
items.signature: export type IndicatorInput = { /** Increments when the arrays are updated in place (live ticks). */ revision?: number; time: number[]; open: number[]; high: number[]; low: number[]; close: number[]; volume: number[]; /** True when the series has real intraday timestamps. */ intraday: boolean; /** Benchmark series values aligned to the bars (chart.setBenchmarkSeries); absent when none is set. */ benchmark?: number[]; };

items.name: IndicatorSource

items.name: StreamOutput
items.doc: Output wiring of a streaming indicator. `shift` moves values right (+, with projection slots past the last bar when `projection`) or left (−).

members.doc: Follow the container's size (default true). When false, `width`/`height` are used.

members.doc: Draw the crosshair (default true). Crosshair events fire either way.

members.name: utcOffsetMinutes
members.doc: Offset used for intraday time labels, in minutes east of UTC (default 330 = IST). Ignored when `timeZone` is set.

members.name: timeZone
members.doc: v0.3: IANA time zone for time labels (daylight saving handled), e.g. "America/New_York".

members.name: locale
members.doc: v0.3: BCP 47 locale for time labels (default "en-GB").

members.name: followLatest
members.doc: Keep the newest bar in view when live updates append bars (default false: the viewport stays where the user left it). Only follows when the newest bar was already visible.

items.name: ChartTime
items.doc: Public, framework-independent XChart SDK contracts (v0.2). Canonical time: every `time` is a UTC Unix timestamp in whole SECONDS. Daily (or longer) bars use 00:00:00 UTC of the trading date, which is how TradestXPro's end-of-day data is stored; intraday bars use the actual bar-open instant.

items.name: CloudData
items.doc: Two boundaries at one time (cloud / band series). `upper` may fall below `lower` (a crossing).

members.name: upColor
members.doc: Fill where upper ≥ lower (default translucent green).

members.name: downColor
members.doc: Fill where upper < lower (default translucent red).

members.name: opacity
members.doc: Multiplies the fill colours' alpha (0–1, default 1).

members.name: lineVisible
members.doc: Draw the boundary lines (default true).

members.name: displacement
members.doc: Shift the drawing by whole bars: positive = forward (projection space), negative = back.

members.name: time
members.doc: Time under the pointer (may be past the last bar), or null when the pointer left the chart.

members.name: price
members.doc: Main-pane price under the pointer; null outside the main pane or when the pointer left.

members.name: seriesData
members.doc: Data of each series at `time` (series without a point there are absent).

members.name: indicators
members.doc: v0.3: indicator output values at `time` (absent during warm-up or gaps).

members.name: projected
members.doc: v0.3: true when `time` lies after the last real candle (projected indicator space, not market data).

members.name: display
members.signature: display?: { open: number; high: number; low: number; close: number }
members.doc: v0.3: the drawn (transformed) candle when the chart type is a display transform such as Heikin Ashi; `seriesData` keeps the real OHLC.

members.name: derived
members.doc: v0.3.1: on price-based chart types, the derived point under the pointer. `seriesData` then holds the ORIGINAL source candle (the observed market price); derived values are chart constructs, never executable prices.

members.name: color
members.doc: Colour when `colorMode` is "single".

members.name: upColor
members.doc: Colours for values ≥ 0 / < 0 ("sign") or rising / falling candles ("candle").

members.name: colorMode
members.doc: "sign" (default): by value sign. "candle": by the candlestick series' direction (volume). "single": one colour.

members.name: opacity
members.doc: 0–1, default 0.8.

members.name: pane
members.doc: Default "separate" (own pane with a zero baseline).

members.name: priceScaleId
members.doc: v0.3 (main pane): "right" (default, the main scale), "left", or an overlay scale id with its own range.

members.name: precision
members.doc: Decimal places for this series' price label; omit for automatic.

members.name: lastValueVisible
members.doc: Show the latest value on the price axis (default true).

members.name: height
members.doc: Current height in px (null before the first layout without explicit sizes).

members.name: moveTo
members.doc: Position among the panes below the main pane (1 = directly below).

members.name: seriesCount
members.doc: Series currently on this scale (main pane).

items.name: PriceScaleMode
items.doc: "percentage" / "indexed" are relative to the first visible bar (indexed: first visible = 100). Display transforms only: data is never changed.

members.name: mode
members.doc: "logarithmic" applies to the main price pane.

members.name: autoScale
members.doc: Fit the price axis to the visible data (default true).

members.name: precision
members.doc: Fixed decimal places for price-axis labels; omit for automatic.

items.name: PriceScaleSettings
items.signature: export type PriceScaleSettings = { /** Independent per scale (right, left, overlay and pane scales). Percentage / indexed are relative to the first visible value of the scale's first series. */ mode?: "normal" | "logarithmic" | "percentage" | "indexed"; /** false needs a manual `range` (except the main right scale, which keeps its dragged range). */ autoScale?: boolean; /** Manual range [min, max] in price units. */ range?: [number, number]; /** Fractions of the pane kept free above and below the data on this scale. */ margins?: { top: number; bottom: number }; /** "left" scale: show its axis labels (default true). */ visible?: boolean; /** Higher values drawn lower. */ invert?: boolean; /** Axis label decimals. */ precision?: number; /** Labels rounded to multiples of this tick size. */ minMove?: number; /** Custom axis label (receives the displayed value: % / indexed value in those modes). Not saved in layouts. */ formatter?: (value: number) => string; };
